item.title: Backing up MongoDB with Plakar
item.description: Plakar now backs up MongoDB. One package, a connection string, and your collections land encrypted and deduplicated in a store you own. Our first NoSQL database, after PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQL Server.
